verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a human-readable API Reference and a markdown rendering of that page for AI agents. Neither is a machine-readable API specification such as OpenAPI. The probe found no spec at any of the common OpenAPI or Swagger paths on the docs domain, though that only checks a few locations and does not prove Datadog publishes none. The markdown docs page is adjacent support, not the downloadable spec the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
